title.en: An Act Providing for Four Additional Assistant Provincial Fiscals for the Province of Camarines Sur, Amending for This Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administration Code, as Amended
title.orig: An Act Providing for Four Additional Assistant Provincial Fiscals for the Province of Camarines Sur, Amending for This Purpose Section Sixteen Hundred Seventy-Four of the Administration Code, as Amended

text.en:
The provision of Section sixteen hundred seventy-four of the Administrative Code, as amended, relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the Province of Camarines Sur, is further amended to read as follows:
"Camarines Sur, eight assistant provincial fiscals;"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
